series.vi_title: Cao Võ: Hạ Cánh Đến Một Vạn Năm Sau

policy.note: Do not copy prose from existing Vietnamese releases. External releases are used only to lock names and terminology.

evidence: Vietnamese manhua listings and character references consistently identify the protagonist as Lục Thánh.
Vietnamese novel translations also use Lục Thánh.
Original novel chapter list identifies the three-eyed opponent as 帝留厄斯.
Vietnamese novel text later renders 帝留厄斯 as Đế Lưu Ách Tư; one older listing uses Tillius, so Đế Lưu Ách Tư is retained as the closer established Sino-Vietnamese form.
Vietnamese novel text repeatedly uses Cực Dương chi lực / Cực Dương for the 极阳 power system.
Original novel chapter 633 is explicitly titled with 毁灭法则.
Vietnamese series references use hủy diệt pháp tắc for this ability.
Original novel repeatedly uses 主宰级 for this rank.
Vietnamese novel chapter listings render 主宰级 as Chúa Tể cấp.
Composed from the confirmed series rank 主宰级 → cấp Chúa Tể and 血脉 → huyết mạch; this ordering is chosen for natural Vietnamese dialogue.
Original novel chapter 646 is titled 堕域之矢, matching the move named in this manhua scene.
Use the compact Hán-Việt technique name for consistency with manhua/novel naming conventions.

The series' original novel uses 星空 and 星海 in this arc; Vietnamese novel usage strongly favors tinh không for general outer-space narration. Use tinh hải only when the source specifically carries the sea-of-stars image.

web_research.notes: Vietnamese manhua chapter pages are image-based and not text-indexed reliably, so ambiguous arc-specific terms were cross-checked against the original Chinese novel chapter list and Vietnamese novel renderings.
